negative_reviews.author: a a
negative_reviews.text:
The food was lovely as always, but the server was very rude, laughing to our faces when we asked him for extra spoon and extra plate, asking “do you need that”? And later never brought what we asked for.
Overall it’s fine, but maybe need to change the staff members in order to keep the restaurant busy.
